胡太太/婶娘: Mrs Hu / your wife in Seventh Lady’s speech; distinct from Hu’s mother
小房子: little house, the separate rented home where Hu and adult A’qiao live
西厢记: Romance of the Western Chamber; allusive shorthand for the lovers’ whole history
小星/外室: concubine within the household / mistress maintained outside it
保险灯: safety lamp, source name for the suspended kerosene lamp
第六章家规: Hu’s wife permits bringing a concubine into the household but forbids maintaining a separate establishment; Seventh Lady refuses to conceal the affair
